data.one_liner: Create animated solid, dashed, and dotted gradient borders with customizable glow effects.
data.what_it_does: Gradient Glow Border is a Flutter package that adds animated gradient borders to any widget. It supports solid, dashed, and dotted styles, customizable border radii, glow effects, and animation controls.
use_when: You need to draw animated gradient borders around containers or widgets.
You require customizable dashed, dotted, or solid gradient border styles with glow shadows.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based animations or vector graphics (consider rive).
You are building standard non-animated Material borders.
strengths: Supports multiple styles including solid, dashed, and dotted gradient borders.
Includes built-in glow effects with blur and spread radius.
Provides simple factory constructors for fast implementation.
weaknesses: Limited to border and glow decoration effects.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want general-purpose animation utilities for various widget properties rather than strictly gradient borders.

data.minimal_example:
SizedBox(
  height: 70,
  width: double.infinity,
  child: GradientGlowBorder.solid(
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(15)),
    colors: [
      Colors.blue,
      Colors.red,
    ],
    child: Center(
      child: Text("Mohamed Elbaiomy"),
    ),
  ),
)
